category: Usenet provider (United States, three backbones) - no free trial

free_tier.stated: None on the page read. The home page is a plan and block table and carries no trial, no free allowance and no free account: "Monthly Unlimited $9", "Triple Play Monthly $13", "Unlimited Yearly $75", blocks 50 GB/$6 to 2000 GB/$75.
free_tier.notes: The claim is about this page, not about the company: a trial could exist behind a path not linked from the home page. No such path is linked.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap is published. The unit of retrieval is a Usenet article, roughly 750 KB by convention.

retention.stated: "Up to 5,915+ Days Binary Retention" on every plan row.

egress.terms: Unlimited usage on the subscription plans; blocks are prepaid by volume and "never expire and do not renew automatically". No overage price is published.

interface_detail: NNTP, 100 connections, SSL. The schema has no nntp token, so the array says unknown.
chaining: Its value for a user is the bundled access: every plan advertises "Supernews Access, ViperNews Access, Usenet.Farm Access", so one $9 month reaches three backbones that each want their own account elsewhere.

limits.value: unlimited on subscriptions; blocks 50 GB to 2000 GB, non-expiring

binding_note: The monthly unlimited plan has no byte counter and 100 connections; at 1 TiB/month nothing in the vocabulary fails. The entry cost is the constraint, and it is money rather than identity.

identity_cost.detail: Every route on the page is a checkout link into /member/billing; there is no free path to register. The instrument at checkout was not read.

reliability_note: No suspension or throttle report was read. Block accounts are advertised as non-expiring and non-renewing.
confidence_note: Prices, retention and the absence of a trial are quoted from the vendor home page read today. Nothing was purchased.

evidence.proved: "Monthly Unlimited $9", "Triple Play Monthly $13", "Unlimited Yearly $75", block prices from 50 GB/$6 to 2000 GB/$75, "Up to 5,915+ Days Binary Retention", "Supernews Access, ViperNews Access, Usenet.Farm Access"

notes: Repeatability: not applicable. Abandonment: if a trial link appears on the home page, this record needs a trial tier.
